```{r Data preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(dplyr)
#library(tidyverse)
set.seed(0)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```


```{r running gllvm LA 2 l.v.}
# Create folder where fitted gllvms are stored
dir.create("gllvm_models/fitting", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)

X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
Y = microbial[, 1:200]
l.v. = 2
set.seed(0)


time_i = system.time({
  gllvm_2 = gllvm(y = Y, X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 

save(gllvm_2, file = file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm_2.RDATA"))
load("gllvm_models/fitting/gllvm_2.RDATA")
pred_mu_gllvm2 = predict(gllvm_2, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
mu = pred_mu_gllvm2

time_gllvm2 = as.numeric(time_i[3])
loglik_new_gllvm2 = sum(dpois(as.matrix(Y), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))

save(time_gllvm2, loglik_new_gllvm2, file = file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm2_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm2_summary.RDATA"))
time_gllvm2
loglik_new_gllvm2
```

```{r alternating glms using 2 l.v.}
dir.create("glm_models/fitting", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)

source("alt_glm.R")

Y = microbial[, 1:200]
```

```{r Rotating, scaling u, lambda}
identify_ulambda <- function(u, lambda) {
  
  # dimensions
  D <- ncol(u)
  
  u_c <- scale(u, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

  # 2. PCA rotation
  pca <- prcomp(u_c, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  
  if (any(pca$sdev < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))) {
    stop("u contains a latent dimension with approximately zero variance.")
  }
  
  # 3. PCA whitening: Cov(UTheta) = I
  Theta <- pca$rotation %*% 
    diag(1 / pca$sdev, nrow = D)
  
  UTheta <- u_c %*% Theta
  
  # Transform Lambda to preserve u_c lambda^T
  Lambda0 <- lambda %*% solve(t(Theta))
  
  # 4. QR identification of Lambda0^T
  qr_L <- qr(t(Lambda0))
  Q <- qr.Q(qr_L)
  R <- qr.R(qr_L)
  
  # 5. Force diagonal of R to be positive
  sgn <- sign(diag(R))
  sgn[sgn == 0] <- 1
  S <- diag(sgn, nrow = D)
  
  #Flips signs in Q and R together, two sign changes cancel after when computing QR
  Q <- Q %*% S 
  R <- S %*% R 
  
  # 6. Final identified U and Lambda
  U <- UTheta %*% Q
  Lambda <- t(R)
  
  return(list(
    U = U,
    Lambda = Lambda
  ))
}
save(identify_ulambda, file = "identify_ulambda.RDATA")
load("identify_ulambda.RDATA")

model_info = list(
  gllvm_LA = list(file = "gllvm_models/fitting/gllvm_2.RDATA", object = "gllvm_2"),
  gllvm_VA = list(file = "gllvm_models/fitting/VA/gllvm_VA2.RDATA", object = "gllvm_VA2"),
  glm = list(file = "glm_models/fitting/glm_2.RDATA", object = "glm_2"),
  jmle_ncolcounts = list(file = "jmle_models/fitting/ncolcounts/jmle_2.RDATA", object = "jmle_2"),
  jmle_ncolu = list(file = "jmle_models/fitting/ncolu/jmle_ncolu2.RDATA", object = "jmle_ncolu2"),
  jmle_sqrt = list(file = "jmle_models/fitting/sqrt/jmle_sqrt2.RDATA", object = "jmle_sqrt2"),
  glmnet_pen1 = list(file = "glmnet_models/fitting/pen1/glmnet_2.RDATA", object = "glmnet_2"),
  glmnet_pen0.1 = list(file = "glmnet_models/fitting/pen0.1/glmnet_pen0.1_2.RDATA", object = "glmnet_pen0.1_2"),
  glmnet_pen0.01 = list(file = "glmnet_models/fitting/pen0.01/glmnet_pen0.01_2.RDATA", object = "glmnet_pen0.01_2")
)

U_all = list()
Lambda_all = list()

for (method in names(model_info)) {
  load(model_info[[method]]$file)
  fit = get(model_info[[method]]$object)
  
  if (method %in% c("gllvm_LA", "gllvm_VA")) {
    ULambda = identify_ulambda(fit$lvs, fit$params$theta %*% diag(fit$params$sigma.lv))
  } else {
    ULambda = identify_ulambda(fit$u, fit$lambda)
  }
  
  U = ULambda$U
  Lambda = ULambda$Lambda

  U_all[[method]] = U
  Lambda_all[[method]] = Lambda
}

```


```{r Biplot}
library(stringr)

manual_biplot <- function(u, lambda, y, n_species = 10, site = Xenv$Xenv.Site,
                          main = "") {
  
  # select species with largest loading magnitude
  load_strength <- sqrt(rowSums(lambda^2))
  selected_sp <- order(load_strength, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_species]
  
  # scale arrows to latent scores
  lambda_sel = lambda[selected_sp, , drop = FALSE]
  
  #make longest arrow 1.2 units long through taking max length of an arrow
  arrow_length = sqrt(rowSums(lambda_sel^2))
  arrow_scale = 2/max(arrow_length)
  
  #colour-code sites
  site = factor(site)
  site_cols = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44",
            "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB", "#000000")
  point_cols = site_cols[as.numeric(site)] 
  
  par(pty = "s")
  plot(
    u[, 1], u[, 2],
    xlab = "LV1",
    ylab = "LV2",
    pch = 16,
    col = point_cols,
    asp = 1,
    xlim = c(-3, 3),
    ylim = c(-4, 2),
    main = main
  )
  
  arrows(
    x0 = 0, y0 = 0,
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 1],
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 2],
    length = 0.08
  )
  
  text(
    jitter(arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 1], amount = 0.2),
    jitter(arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 2], amount = 0.2),
    labels = as.numeric(str_extract(colnames(y), "\\d+"))[selected_sp],
    pos = 4,
    cex = 0.7
  )
  
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = levels(site),
         col = site_cols,
         pch = 16,
         cex = 0.6)
}

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = TRUE)


for (method in names(model_info)) {
  png(
  filename = file.path("figures", paste0(method, "_biplot.png")),
  width = 1800,
  height = 1800,
  res = 300
)
  manual_biplot(U_all[[method]], Lambda_all[[method]], Y, main = paste0("Biplot for ", method, " fit"))
  dev.off()
}
```
